task.title: Block unsafe roadmap task reuse
task.summary: Change roadmap task-boundary assessment so reuse/refinement requires matching requirement IDs and compatible desired outcomes.

goal.outcome: Roadmap creation and planning reuse reject path-only, label-only, or broad-intent merges that combine unrelated accepted outcomes.
acceptance: Task-boundary assessment requires requirement ID overlap and compatible desired outcomes for auto-reuse/refinement.
Shared spec paths, code paths, labels, or decision build refs alone do not justify merging distinct accepted rows.
Create/refine reporting explains unsafe reuse findings with the conflicting row/outcome evidence.
True duplicate work with matching requirement IDs and outcomes can still refine safely.
TASK-specific tests cover unsafe path/label-only reuse rejection and safe requirement/outcome overlap reuse.
non_goals: Do not implement planning coverage residuals.
Do not change closed or archived roadmap history.
Do not add file-structure target accountability findings.
verification: targeted TASK-112 test for task-boundary reuse

closure_brief.user_intent: Prevent roadmap auto-reuse from merging distinct accepted outcomes by shared paths, labels, or broad intent.
implemented_changes: Auto-reuse now requires matching requirement ID and compatible desired outcome.
Unsafe shared path/label matches create separate tasks instead of refining existing work.
Safe same requirement/outcome matches still reuse/refine existing tasks.
Added TASK-112 regression coverage for unsafe and safe reuse.
acceptance_evidence: TASK-112 targeted test proves unsafe merge rejected and safe reuse preserved.
CodeWiki task/source-contract audits passed with warning-only generated graph issues.
non_goals_preserved: No closed/archived roadmap history changes outside normal CodeWiki evidence/build writes.
remaining_risks: Known unrelated package-smoke fixture drift remains: task-close smoke fixture returns block validation path where test expects task-close-pass.

risks: Auto-reuse is stricter by accepted DPA-REQ-005; tasks without requirement IDs will not auto-merge by paths/labels alone.
Known unrelated package-smoke fixture drift remains for later remediation.
